personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK structure + 7 Dark-First Utility typography
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium Web3 vault that pairs cosmic depth and glassmorphism with high-utility tech typography for a Revolut-level crypto experience.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for an expensive, uncrowded feel. Avoid cramped data rows.

do's: Apply to floating bottom tab bar, central FAB, and all main dashboard cards.
Use 1px border with rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) over heavily tinted blurred bases.
Ensure bottom sheets and sticky headers use frosted glass over the cosmic background.
dont's: Do not apply to form fields or body text regions.
Do not stack more than 2 glass surfaces (e.g. glass card + glass button inside is too much).

screens.name: Splash & Welcome
screens.purpose: Introduce the premium cosmic vault experience and prompt onboarding.
screens.layout: Full-bleed cosmic background image. Welcome screen has hero visual, titles perfectly centered, pager dots, and vertically stacked CTAs anchored safely at bottom. Language switcher in top right header.

screens.name: Wallet Setup (Create / Import)
screens.purpose: Securely guide the user through seed phrase generation and verification.

states.error: Inline red toast with retry prompt

screens.layout: Header with centered title and back button. Content vertically centered. The 12-word grid sits in a glassmorphic container. Primary 'Continue' button sticky at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: PIN & Activate
screens.purpose: Secure the vault and process the gasless activation fee.
screens.layout: PIN pad is numeric 3x4 grid, uniformly spaced, no borders. Activate screen has QR code in a glass card, copyable address pill, and progress bar (0.00 / 50 USDT).

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level view of balances, actions, and recent activity.

states.loading: Pulse skeletons for balance and transaction rows
states.empty: Glass card with 'No transactions yet' illustration

screens.layout: Header: Left Avatar (opens drawer), Center Address Pill, Right Bell. Hero: Huge total balance with Space Grotesk. Three circular quick-action buttons (Deposit, Transfer, Withdraw) in a row. Bottom section: List of transactions with sticky section headers.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Detailed, searchable record of all financial movements.
screens.layout: Sticky glass header with Search input and scrolling filter chips (All/Income/Expenses/Transfers). Transactions grouped by day, using Emerald for income (+), Rose for expenses (-). List handles bottom safe area for floating tab bar.

screens.name: Team
screens.purpose: Track referrals, commissions, and invite new members.
screens.layout: Top glass card shows total commissions and tier progress. Two action buttons (Copy Code, Share Link). List of members separated by filter chips. Full width minus padding for cards.

screens.name: Sub-accounts
screens.purpose: Manage segregated vault partitions and goals.
screens.layout: Top allocated total card with a segmented progress bar. Grid or list of sub-account glass cards. Each card has an icon, name, flexible/locked badge, and progress. Sticky 'Create' button.

components.PrimaryButton: LinearGradient from brand to brandPrimary, pill radius, bold text. Disabled state MUST fall back to solid surfaceTertiary with muted text (no dim gradients).
components.FloatingTabBar: Glassmorphic pill spanning mostly full width, safely above home indicator. 3 icons (Home, History, Team). Central FAB sits on top.
components.CentralFAB: Raised circular button. Uses PrimaryButton gradient. Pops up a glass BottomSheet for Deposit/Withdraw/Add Account.
components.Drawer: Triggered by Avatar. Full height side drawer with cosmic background. Lists accounts, settings, and language switch.
components.GlassCard: Background surfaceSecondary (translucent slate). border 1px solid border token. blur effect. shadow_tier 0.

cosmic_background.alt: Abstract dark blue cosmic pattern resembling a starry night sky

empty_state_illustration.alt: Abstract dark illustration for empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's requested palette: Dark mode (navy/near-black), Blue to Cyan gradient (#2563EB to #38BDF8), Emerald for income, Rose for expenses.
Implement the 'Cosmic background' using the provided background image in a full-bleed absolute container with a subtle gradient scrim to ensure text readability.

Disabled Primary Buttons: FIX the reported issue. Do NOT use a dim gradient. A disabled button MUST use a solid `surfaceTertiary` color with `muted` text so it looks intentionally disabled and professional.
Layout Polish: Ensure header titles are perfectly horizontally centered (absolute position if necessary, flanked by back button / language switch).
Spacing: Check the 'Import' page. The content should be vertically balanced, not clustered entirely at the top. Use `flex: 1` and `justifyContent: 'center'` where appropriate.
Floating Tab Bar: Custom implementation. It is a glassmorphic pill resting safely above the home indicator. The `+` FAB is centrally located and slightly raised, overlapping the pill.
Typography: Apply Space Grotesk for big numbers (balances, PIN) and Satoshi for standard UI text. Never mix weights improperly; rely on size (e.g., 2xl/3xl) for hierarchy.
Language/RTL: Ensure UI seamlessly flips or adapts for Arabic (RTL). Include language switch on Splash/Welcome and Drawer.
Images: Always use `expo-linear-gradient` as a scrim over the cosmic background image before placing text, ensuring WCAG AA contrast.
